name: caseAnalysis
_note: Reads artifact.data (LawEnforcementActionPanel.actCase: callMacro('caseAnalysis',{artifact:{data:parsed,title}}) → runDomain → {input:{artifact:{data,title}}} → sole-key peel at dispatch yields artifact.data). SCOPE (S1, written per cross-check #70(d)): when data.caseId resolves to one of the caller's cases on file (by case number, case-insensitive, or by internal id), the evidence actually BOOKED into custody against that case (evidenceIntake store, matched on caseNumber) counts alongside the staged workbench rows — evidenceCount = bookedEvidenceCount + stagedEvidenceCount, result.linkedCase names the resolved case, and result.scope states the population in words (witnesses and suspects remain workbench entries only — no store holds them per case). Unresolved caseId → staged-only scope, stated as such. Before S1 the macro weighed staged rows only, so evidence standing in custody was invisible to the score (review finding F3). caseStrength = round(min(100,evidenceCount*15)*0.4 + min(100,witnesses*20)*0.3 + min(100,suspectLinks*25)*0.3); prosecutable = caseStrength>=60; status strong>=80 / developing>=50 / insufficient. The CaseResult card renders caseId/caseStrength/status/evidenceCount/witnessCount/suspectCount/nextSteps[]/prosecutable/scope. Non-array evidence/witnesses/suspects fall back to 0 counts, never NaN. Component-exact-shape gate: server/tests/law-enforcement-lens-macros.test.js.
